messages:
marie (devex): Heads-up — noticed onboarding README for the Node sample has the wrong env var name. Quickstart shows `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but the SDK uses `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` now. Repro: copied snippet, app errors with 401. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

sam (docs): ugh thanks, that explains the support ticket. can you paste the failing snippet/log?

marie (devex): ```bash
# bad snippet (in README)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-EXAMPLE"
node index.js
# SDK reads process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN -> undefined -> 401
```

jordan (platform): we should avoid real-looking tokens in docs. use placeholders: `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=YOUR_TOKEN_HERE`. also add a short note about token scopes and a retry hint for transient failures: `retry: { retries: 2, backoff: 100 }`. :memo:

lina (eng): i'll open a quick PR to fix Node & Python samples + add a tiny smoke test that runs the samples with dummy tokens. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :thumbsup:

marie (devex): thanks — also found python example uses `client = Redwood(api_key=...)` instead of `Redwood(token=...)`. looks like copy/paste across SDK versions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs site build queued for PR #482.

sam (docs): can we add a CI lint step that runs `node samples/run-quickstart.js` and `python samples/quickstart.py` (with placeholders) to detect snippet drift early?

lina (eng): yep will add tests + a small script that validates env var names match SDK expected vars. ETA EOD.

marie (devex): also noticed an accidental token in an old commit (1690001111). i recommend rotating and adding a docs note, not rewriting history. :lock:

sam (docs): agreed — rotate and patch, add a short note in the changelog about the fix. thanks all! :raised_hands:
